simple.summary: צָנַע (tsânaʻ) means to humiliate First listed occurrence: Mic 6 8.

definitions.full: H6800. tsana [ צָנַע ] verb be modest, humble (perhaps properly be retired , Late Hebrew Hiph`il keep close, reserve, preserve , so אַצְנַע ᵑ7 ; צְנִיעַ retiring, modest ); — Hiph`il Infinitive absolute לֶכֶת הַצְנֵעַ Micah 6:8 a making humble to walk = shewing a humble walk (with God). [ צָנוּעַ ] adjective modest (on formation compare Ba BN § 31 d ); — plural צְנוּעִים Prov 11:9 (see Toy; opposed to זָדוֺן ).
